user.title: Select Sesame 5 Device
user.description: Choose a discovered Sesame 5 smart lock from the list below, or enter its Bluetooth MAC address manually.

manual.title: Enter Device Details
manual.description: Please enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Sesame 5 device.

auth.title: Authenticate with {device_name}
auth.description:
Enter the Secret Key from your Sesame app.

[Real-time Persistent Connection (Recommended)]: Keeps BLE connected for instant status updates, unlock automations, and one-time passcode auto-deletion.
[Power-Saving Mode Limitations]: Connects only on-demand or periodically. Real-time manual unlock detection and instant one-time passcode deletion will be delayed or unavailable.

data.read_only: Read-only mode (Monitor state and battery only; disable remote operations)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Sesame device via Bluetooth. Please ensure the device is within range.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Please verify that your Secret Key or QR Code matches this device.
error.invalid_key_format: Unrecognized key format. Please provide a valid Sesame QR code URL or 16-byte key.

abort.already_configured: This Sesame device is already configured.

init.title: Sesame 5 BLE Options
init.description:
[Real-time Mode]: Maintains persistent BLE connection for instant state feedback, automations, and one-time passcode auto-deletion.
[Power-Saving Mode Limitations]: Disconnects after idle. Real-time physical unlock events cannot be pushed to HA until the next connection.
[Read-Only Mode]: Prevents remote unlock, lock, or passcode modifications.

data.refresh_interval: Periodic refresh interval in minutes (Power-Saving Mode only; 0 = on-demand)
data.history_tag: History Tag (Name shown in App unlock history)
